text: Abel: Heb. Hebel | keeper: Heb. a feeder
in process of time: Heb. at the end of days
be accepted?: Or, have the excellency? | unto thee: Or, subject unto thee
My punishment is greater, then I can bear: Or, my iniquity is greater then that it may be forgiven
I have slain a man to my wounding: Or, I would slay a man in my wound, etc. | hurt: Or, in my hurt
Enos: Heb. Enosh | call upon the Name of the LORD: Or, to call themselves by the Name of the LORD
